welcomeTitle: A little care for the everyday.
welcomeText: One place for the things you need. Your lists live on your server, so this browser and your phone always show the same thing.
signInText: Sign in with your identity provider to open your lists.
serverUnavailable: The server is unavailable. Try again when your connection returns.
ssoDisabled: Account sign-in is not configured on this server yet.
listSubtitle: A small list. One less thing on your mind.
emptyText: Add the first thing you need. Everyone with access sees it right away.
name: Name
accountSubtitle: Your sign-in, your sessions, your choice.
sessionHelp: Revoking a session signs that browser out at once. Connected phones are listed separately.
adminHelp: Disabling an account signs it out of every browser and phone. These controls do not show or change anyone’s lists.
confirmDisableText: This account is signed out of every browser and phone at once. Its lists stay on the server.
confirmRevokeText: The affected browsers must sign in again.
forbidden: Access is no longer available. Sign in again or ask an administrator.
unauthenticated: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
upgrade_required: This change needs a newer version of Usuals. Reload this page, then try again.
too_large: This list is too large for the server. Remove some items, then try again.
rate_limited: The server is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
invalid: This action could not be completed. Try again.
not_found: This list or account is no longer available.
unavailable: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
invalidName: Enter an item name of at most 1,000 characters.
localSignInText: Use your account on this server.
passwordHelp: Use 15 to 128 characters. Spaces are preserved.
activationText: Your server administrator provides this secret. Activation opens your account on this server.
passwordChanged: Account password changed. Sign in again.
createUserText: Create a local account and hand its one-use activation secret to that person through a trusted channel.
usernameHelp: 3 to 64 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. No email address. Usernames are lowercase.
resetPasswordText: Existing sessions are revoked. Give the new one-use secret to this person privately.
activationSecretText: Copy this secret now and deliver it privately. It is shown only once and expires at {date}. Never put it in a link.
invalidPassword: Use an account password of 15 to 128 characters, without control characters.
invalidUsername: Enter a username of 3 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
localLoginFailed: The username, password or one-use secret could not be verified. Try again.
appearanceHint: Choose your palette. Light and dark follow your device.
palette_grove_description: Botanical greens and soft oat tones.
palette_tide_description: Ink blue, sea glass and cool paper.
tutorialWelcomeBody: Usuals keeps your shopping lists on your server. This browser and your phone show the same lists, and a change on one appears on the other within seconds.
tutorialWelcomeHint: You can skip now and reopen Guided tour from Preferences at any time.
tutorialListBody: Add what you need, tick it off in the shop and edit any item with ···. Finish shopping moves picked-up items into your history.
tutorialListHint: List options lets you rename a list or import items from a note, a recipe or a photo.
importModelMemory: This connection and its key stay only in memory until this dialog closes. Requests go directly from your browser to the provider.
importNoModelOrigins: Your server has no image-model endpoints enabled. Ask its operator to allow a provider origin. Markdown import remains available.
importMarkdownHelp: Paste a note from Google Keep or another app, or open a UTF-8 text or Markdown file. Use one item per line, bullets or checkboxes. Import stays on this device; checked items are skipped.
importPhotoHelp: Choose a JPEG or PNG, or use your camera. The photo stays here until you choose Read photo. An automatic check confirms image support before upload.
importEmpty: No usable entries were found. Try another source.
importMarkdownReviewHelp: Check each name and quantity from your list. Existing items are skipped, and your list changes only when you confirm.
importReviewHelp: Check each name and quantity. Model results can be wrong. Existing items are skipped, and your list changes only when you confirm.
importFailed: Could not import this source. Your saved list is kept.
importModelEndpoint: Enter a valid model API base URL from the allowed origins, and a model name. Use HTTPS, except for localhost.
importModelBudget: This connection has reached its model-call limit. Connect again with a suitable limit if you want to continue.
importModelMissing: Connect an image model first. No photo was sent.
importModelImages: The model did not pass the image check. Choose an image-capable model. No photo was sent.
importModelAuth: The provider rejected this connection. Check your API key.
importModelConnection: Could not reach the model. Check its URL, connection and browser CORS access.
importModelOutput: The model returned no usable structured reply. Try again or use Markdown.
importImageInvalid: Choose a readable JPEG or PNG photo.
importTooLarge: This source is too large. Use at most 30,000 Markdown characters, 150 entries or a photo of at most 10 MB.
importMarkdownInvalid: Choose a UTF-8 Markdown or plain text file.
importCameraFailed: Could not use the camera. Check permission or choose a photo file.
connectionCompare: Check that the phone shows the same code before approving.
connectionCompared: The phone shows the same code.
serverAiPrivacy: Only text or photos you explicitly submit are sent to this server’s selected AI provider.
serverAiLocal: The operator declares processing on its own infrastructure.
serverAiKeyHelp: This key is sent to your server and stored encrypted. A blank key uses the operator’s provider configuration.
ai_unavailable: AI is unavailable on this server.
ai_budget: Daily AI allowance reached. Try again tomorrow.
ai_images_unverified: Check image support again before sending a photo.
ai_credentials_unavailable: Personal key storage is unavailable. Ask the server administrator.
ai_configuration_changed: The AI provider changed. Open AI settings and confirm the new provider before trying again.
importRecipeTextHelp: Paste recipe text. Reading with server AI sends this text to the displayed server and provider; review the result before adding.
serverAiConfigured: Your server has already configured AI assistance. You can use it directly when importing.
connectPhoneIntro: Scan this code with your phone to open your lists there. The phone connects as soon as it scans, so keep this code to yourself.
connectPhoneStepScan: On the phone, scan the code with the camera or in Usuals.
connectPhoneWaiting: Waiting for your phone to scan this code.
connectLandingText: Open this code in the Usuals app on this phone to connect it to your account.
connectionReturn: Go back to Usuals on the phone to continue.
firstListText: Name a list here, or connect your phone from Account: the lists on your phone appear here once it is connected.
allListsArchived: All your lists are archived. Start a new one or restore one below.
deleteListText: The list and its history are deleted for everyone who has access. This cannot be undone.
leaveListText: The list disappears from your browser and phone. Anyone who still has access can share it with you again.
archiveListOwnerText: The list is archived for everyone who has access and keeps its items and history. You can restore it from Archived at any time.
archiveListText: The list is archived only for you. Everyone else still sees it. You can restore it from Archived at any time.
archivedByOwner: Archived by the owner. Only the owner can restore it.
finished: Picked-up items moved to your history: {count}.
sharedText: Everyone here sees changes within seconds and can add or tick off items.
privateText: This list is not shared yet. Choose Share to shop together.
shareNoMatch: No one on this server matches.
shareNoPeople: There is no one else on this server yet. An administrator can add accounts.
shareEveryone: Everyone listed already has access. Search to find others.
shareHelp: Everyone with access can edit the list and add people. Only the owner can remove people or delete the list.
conflict_stale: Someone changed this item at the same time, so your change was not applied. Check it and try again.
conflict_unit: This item is already on the list in a unit that cannot be added up, so nothing changed.
conflict_identity: Another item on the list already has this name, so your change was not applied.
conflict_alias_stale: The list’s item names changed meanwhile, so your change was not applied. Try again.
rejected: The server did not accept this change. The list shows what it holds now.
list_exists: This list could not be created. Try again.
limit_reached: This goes over the server’s limits: 50 people per list and 500 lists per owner.
connectPhoneStepOpen: Usuals opens on the phone with the same lists as here.
connectQr: QR code to connect your phone
connectExpired: This code expired. Create a new one.
phonesHelp: A connected phone shows the same lists as this browser. Disconnecting signs it out; your lists stay on the server.
phoneExpiry: Connected until {date}, longer while in use
disconnectText: The phone is signed out and stops syncing. Your lists stay on the server, and you can connect it again at any time.
tutorialShareTitle: Share with the people you shop with.
tutorialShareBody: Choose Share on a list and pick people with an account on this server. They see the list at once and can edit it too.
tutorialShareHint: To use your phone, open Account and choose Connect a phone.
quietAccountHelp: Set up or reset an account
quietRemoveItemHelp: This item leaves the list. Past purchases stay in your history.
inviteDeliveryFailed: Email could not be sent. Try resending.
inviteExpired: Invitation expired. Send a new invitation.
invitationIntro: Create an account or sign in to accept your invitation. You can use Usuals in your browser.
invitationWrongAccount: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Switch account to sign out at the sign-in service, then use that address.
invitationReauthenticate: Please sign in again to confirm your current email address.
invitationUnavailableText: This invitation has expired, was cancelled, or is no longer valid. Ask the sender for a new invitation.
inviteHelp: Invite someone by email. They can register and join this list. Only accepted invitations give access.
inviteBetaHelp: Send an invitation to register on this server. It does not give access to existing lists or administrator privileges.
inviteEmailBody: {name} invited you to Usuals. Open the invitation to get started in your browser. This invitation expires in 7 days.
inviteEmailFooter: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
invitation_unavailable: This invitation is no longer available.
invitation_wrong_account: Sign in with the email address that received this invitation.
reauthentication_required: Sign in again to confirm your email address.
email_verification_required: Verify your email address with your sign-in provider first.
invitation_required: An invitation is required to join this server.
invitation_resend_later: Wait a minute before resending this invitation.
emailSignInText: Create a list or sign in to keep shopping together.
account_switch_unavailable: To use another email, sign out at your sign-in provider or open the invitation in another browser profile.
ai_monthly_budget: Monthly AI allowance reached. It resets at the start of the next UTC month.
